description:
Optum is a global organization that delivers care, aided by technology to help millions of people live healthier lives. The work you do with our team will directly improve health outcomes by connecting people with the care, pharmacy benefits, data and resources they need to feel their best. Here, you will find a culture guided by inclusion, talented peers, comprehensive benefits and career development opportunities. Come make an impact on the communities we serve as you help us advance health optimization on a global scale. Join us to start **Caring. Connecting. Growing together.**

 **Primary Responsibilities:**

* Design, develop, validate, and deploy predictive and prescriptive analytics solutions to address complex business problems
* Build, optimize, and operationalize machine learning models across classification, regression, forecasting, recommendation systems, clustering, and optimization use cases
* Perform exploratory data analysis (EDA), feature engineering, and data preparation to uncover patterns, trends, and actionable insights
* Develop and validate statistical models using appropriate methodologies, ensuring model robustness, reliability, and interpretability
* Apply statistical techniques such as hypothesis testing, experiment design, sampling, regression analysis, and time\-series modeling to solve business challenges
* Monitor model performance in production, identify model drift, and implement continuous improvement and retraining strategies
* Translate business requirements into analytical frameworks and scalable ML solutions
* Develop and operationalize AI/ML solutions leveraging both traditional machine learning and Generative AI techniques
* Apply Natural Language Processing (NLP), Large Language Models (LLMs), Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG), and agentic AI frameworks to solve real\-world business problems
* Evaluate, benchmark, and compare model performance using industry\-standard evaluation frameworks, metrics, and best practices
* Comply with the terms and conditions of the employment contract, company policies and procedures, and any and all directives (such as, but not limited to, transfer and/or re\-assignment to different work locations, change in teams and/or work shifts, policies in regards to flexibility of work benefits and/or work environment, alternative work arrangements, and other decisions that may arise due to the changing business environment). The Company may adopt, vary or rescind these policies and directives in its absolute discretion and without any limitation (implied or otherwise) on its ability to do so

**Required Qualifications:**

* 6\+ years of experience in Data Science, Machine Learning, Applied Statistics, or a related field
* Hands\-on experience with Python, SQL, and leading ML frameworks such as Scikit\-learn, XGBoost, TensorFlow, or PyTorch
* Solid understanding of machine learning algorithms, statistical modeling techniques, model validation, and model risk management practices
* Familiarity with MLOps practices, CI/CD pipelines, model monitoring, and production deployment frameworks

 **Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience with cloud\-based AI/ML platforms (Azure ML, AWS SageMaker, or GCP Vertex AI)
* Experience working with Generative AI, LLMs, RAG architectures, and AI agents

 *At UnitedHealth Group, our mission is to help people live healthier lives and make the health system work better for everyone. We believe everyone\-of every race, gender, sexuality, age, location and income\-deserves the opportunity to live their healthiest life. Today, however, there are still far too many barriers to good health which are disproportionately experienced by people of color, historically marginalized groups and those with lower incomes. We are committed to mitigating our impact on the environment and enabling and delivering equitable care that addresses health disparities and improves health outcomes \- an enterprise priority reflected in our mission.*

description:
Through our dedicated associates, Conduent delivers mission\-critical services and solutions on behalf of Fortune 100 companies and over 500 governments \- creating exceptional outcomes for our clients and the millions of people who count on them. You have an opportunity to personally thrive, make a difference and be part of a culture where individuality is noticed and valued every day.
   

  

**Job Overview**
 Do you enjoy deep hands\-on development and leading other developers in to build modern Analytics, AI, and Generative AI technologies and solutions? Do you enjoy mentoring engineers, driving technical excellence, and delivering complex enterprise solutions?
   

  

 Conduent is seeking a Senior AI Solutions Engineer / Technical Lead with strong cloud, application development, data, analytics, and Generative AI expertise to join our Analytics \& Data Science Practice.This role serves as the senior developer for Analytics, AI, and GenAI solution delivery initiatives. The individual will lead technical implementation, and ensure engineering best practices are consistently applied across projects. The role combines hands\-on technical leadership with responsibility for solution quality, delivery execution, engineering standards, and mentoring of junior engineers. Success in this role is measured by the ability to successfully deliver complex Analytics and AI solutions through technical leadership, team enablement, and disciplined engineering execution.
   

  

**Responsibilities:**
 Lead technical implementation and delivery of Analytics, AI, and GenAI solutions across multiple projects.
   

  

 Lead design and development of GenAI applications leveraging Azure AI Foundry, Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Search, and related Azure services.
   

  

 Design and implement Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) solutions, agent\-based workflows, prompt orchestration frameworks, and AI\-enabled business applications.
   

  

 Build scalable APIs, services, integrations, and cloud\-native applications supporting AI solutions.
   

  

 Implement application security, observability, monitoring, testing, and operational readiness capabilities.
   

  

 Translate architecture, \& functional requirements into detailed technical designs and implementation plans.
   

  

 Partner with Architects and Product Leaders to ensure solutions align with enterprise architecture standards and platform capabilities.
   

  

 Establish and enforce development standards, coding practices, testing standards, and deployment processes.
   

  

 Conduct code reviews and technical quality assessments.
   

  

 Ensure solutions meet scalability, performance, security, maintainability, and reliability requirements.
   

  

 Support production readiness reviews, deployment planning, operational handoff, and incident resolution activities.
   

  

 Participate in architecture reviews and contribute to reusable platform capabilities and accelerators.
   

  

 Promote adoption of reusable frameworks, components, development patterns, and DevOps practices.
   

  

 Guide engineers on architecture patterns, coding practices, cloud technologies, GenAI development, and troubleshooting approaches.
   

  

 Mentor junior engineers and support onboarding and development of new team members.
   

  

 Assist in technical interviews and candidate evaluations.
   

  

**Experience Needed:**
 10\+ years of experience in software engineering, cloud engineering, analytics, AI, data engineering, or application development.
   

  

 3\+ years leading technical delivery teams or serving as a technical lead on enterprise projects developing and delivering cloud\-native applications and services. Hands\-on Azure experience is required.
   

  

 Experience delivering enterprise Analytics, AI, or GenAI solutions into production environments.
   

  

 Experience working in Agile delivery environments and cross\-functional teams.
   

  

 Hands\-on expertise to develop and deploy applications on Azure, including services such as App Service, Azure Functions, Container Apps, Azure AI Foundry, AKS, Storage, Key Vault, API Management, or similar components
   

  

 Hands\-on experience delivering GenAI solutions into production environments including prompt and RAG (retrieval\-augmented generation) patterns, responsible AI controls \& guardrails, AI orchestration, AI/ML model lifecycle management, and secure integration of AI capabilities into analytics and enterprise applications.
   

  

 Strong Python development skills.
   

  

 Experience building REST APIs, microservices and implementing cloud\-native applications.
   

  

 Strong understanding of software architecture principles and design patterns.
   

  

 Experience building containerized applications using Docker and Kubernetes technologies.
   

  

 Familiarity with front\-end application development and modern application frameworks.
   

  

 Experience with: CI/CD pipelines, Infrastructure\-as\-Code, Test automation, Monitoring and observability, Production support processes, Root cause analysis and Performance optimization
   

  

 BS or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Science, or a related technical discipline.
   

  

**Additional Requirements:**
 Strong written and verbal communication skills.
   

  

 Ability to work directly with technical and business stakeholders.
   

  

 Experience supporting global onshore/offshore delivery models.
   

  

 Strong problem\-solving and analytical skills.
   

  

 Ability to balance hands\-on development responsibilities with technical leadership responsibilities.
   

  

 Passion for emerging Analytics, AI, and GenAI technologies.
